'''D'Voras Brin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]]. He was know to work for both sides during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], willing to take work from either the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] or the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] if the money was good. Brin wore black and red clothing, and hid his face with a hooded cloak. He had long, dark hair, and an unkempt beard and mustache. His weapon of choice was a heavily modified [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blaster]] that had been pared down to the size of a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], which was kept in a specially adapted holster. During the Galactic Civil War, the Rebel trooper [[Stannik Nhaa]], considered contracting Brin to smuggle him off-world.
